text: I'll start with the paged workload.

remediation.name: checkout-worker
remediation.required_value: env entry name: AMQP_URL with the checkout queue URL, e.g. - name: AMQP_URL\n  value: amqp://rabbitmq.payments.svc.cluster.local:5672/

arguments.root_cause_statement: Deployment payments/checkout-worker ships a container whose startup command hard-requires the AMQP_URL environment variable, but the pod template defines no env at all. Every container start therefore hits the guard clause, prints "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set" and exits 1, so the kubelet keeps restarting it into CrashLoopBackOff (restart count 5) and the Deployment stays at 0/1 Ready, which is what the availability monitor paged on and why no checkout jobs are consumed. Nothing in namespace payments supplies the value either: the only ConfigMap present is kube-root-ca.crt and there are no Secrets, so the fix is to add the AMQP_URL env var (with the queue URL) to the Deployment's container spec.
arguments.mechanism: Deployment payments/checkout-worker's container "worker" runs the command `[ -n "${AMQP_URL:-}" ] || { echo "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set"; exit 1; }`, but .spec.template.spec.containers[name=worker].env is absent — the running pod reports `Environment:    <none>` instead of an AMQP_URL entry. The container therefore exits with `Exit Code:    1` after logging `FATAL: AMQP_URL not set`, and the kubelet backs off restarting it (`Reason:       CrashLoopBackOff`, `Restart Count:  5`), leaving the Deployment at ready=0/1.

evidence.claim: The paged Deployment is 0/1 Ready and its only pod is crash-looping.
The worker container is in CrashLoopBackOff with repeated Error exits.
The Deployment pod template's container command requires AMQP_URL and exits 1 when it is unset, and the template declares no env block.
The previous container instance died on exactly that guard clause.
The running pod has no environment variables at all, so AMQP_URL never reaches the container.
The container terminates with exit code 1 and the kubelet backs it off.
No ConfigMap in namespace payments carries a queue URL; only the injected CA bundle ConfigMap exists.
No Secret in namespace payments could supply AMQP_URL either.
evidence.quote: 0 objects of kind secrets in namespace payments

ruled_out.alternative: Image pull failure or a bad image reference caused the crash loop
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The image is present on the node and the container is created and started successfully each time; it dies afterwards in its own command.
ruled_out.quote: Container image "busybox:1.36" already present on machine and can be accessed by the pod

ruled_out.alternative: Scheduling / node capacity or taints kept the pod from running
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The pod was scheduled and is Running on the node; the failure is inside the container.

ruled_out.alternative: A missing ConfigMap or Secret reference in the pod template failed to mount or inject
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The template references no ConfigMap or Secret for env at all — there is no envFrom or valueFrom to fail; the only volume is the default service-account projection.
